attempts.feedback:
Proven correct. Cost: 1.09 cycles per call, clang: 1.35.
Can you make it even faster? If you believe this version is optimal, answer NO_IMPROVEMENT and one sentence why.

attempts.response:
NO_IMPROVEMENT
Any correct mapping 0->1,1->2 must perform an increment requiring at least one ALU uop plus ret, and leal 1(%rdi),%eax already attains this minimum with the cheapest single-uop simple LEA bottlenecked by ret throughput.
